replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset. To perform PCA, you first need to standardize the data. Then, you compute the covariance matrix of the data. Next, you compute the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the covariance matrix.
